server_description: Query BooksOntology, the live book performance map in Fabric IQ, as the signed-in user. Entities and keys: Title (TitleId), Edition (EditionId: format and print terms), TitleSignal (SignalId: this week's signals, with SignalType, Headline, OpportunityAtRiskGbp, IsMaterial, RecommendedOption), DecisionOption (OptionId: each signal's options, with OptionName, IsRecommended, InvestmentGbp, RevenueProtectedGbp, RemainingRiskGbp, ArrivalDays, KeyAssumption, PrimaryRisk), TitlePerformance (TitleId: this week's sales and momentum), Campaign (CampaignId) and ReprintRequest (RequestId). Ask exactly one question about the rows of one entity, with every condition in it and each value in quotes, naming the key and the properties you need. For what needs attention, ask: Which TitleSignal rows have the IsMaterial value "Yes"? Return each SignalId, TitleName, SignalType, Headline, OpportunityAtRiskGbp and RecommendedOption. Copy values as returned, and cite each row with its own marker, by entity and key. Read-only.
